description: Source file implementing the BundleData class for managing bundle-related data, including asset catalog directories, file rules, and output file generation within a build system.

classes.name: BundleData
classes.description: Class managing bundle data, including asset catalogs, file rules, and output file generation.

methods.name: GetAssetsCatalogDirectory
methods.description: Finds the directory of an asset catalog (.xcassets) from a source file path.

methods.name: AddBundleData
methods.description: Adds a target to the bundle dependencies, filtering based on patterns and bundle type.

methods.name: OnTargetResolved
methods.description: Initializes file rules and asset catalog sources when a target is resolved.

methods.name: GetSourceFiles
methods.description: Collects source files associated with bundle file rules and asset catalogs.

methods.name: GetOutputFiles
methods.description: Generates output files for a target based on bundle data.

methods.name: GetOutputsAsSourceFiles
methods.description: Retrieves source files representing the output files of the bundle.

methods.name: GetCompiledAssetCatalogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the compiled asset catalog (.car file).

methods.name: GetBundleRootDirOutput
methods.description: Returns the root directory path of the bundle as a SourceFile.

methods.name: GetBundleRootDirOutputAsDir
methods.description: Returns the root directory path of the bundle as a SourceDir.

methods.name: GetBundleDir
methods.description: Returns the directory of the bundle.
